plugins.name: CAP Token Usage Tracker (fork)
plugins.description: Fork of AITNR/cap-token-usage-tracker. One dashboard with no management key prompt: prices, reset, export and the API key columns are all reachable directly, with API keys masked server-side. Date presets include the current day and gain an "All" range, the per-request table shows the model alias, model prices resolve through the alias, and the full-mode reset route no longer 404s.
